import json
from java.util import ArrayList
from ghidra.program.model.pcode import JumpTable
from ghidra.program.disassemble import Disassembler
from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet
p=currentProgram
a=p.getAddressFactory()
fm=p.getFunctionManager()
rows=[]
for start,size,site,entries in [["1421be370",12533,"1421be644",["1421bee7b","1421bed43","1421be646","1421be646","1421bfa68","1421bf751"]],["140df3e70",431,"140df3e91",["140df3e93","140df3f8e","140df3ec2","140df3f74","140df3eb4"]],["1421bb740",564,"1421bb76e",["1421bb770","1421bb88b","1421bb784","1421bb871","1421bb897","1421bb959"]]]:
 begin=a.getAddress(start)
 fn=fm.getFunctionAt(begin)
 tx=p.startTransaction('Original bounded jump table override')
 ok=False
 try:
  dest=ArrayList()
  restriction=AddressSet(begin,begin.add(size-1))
  for e in entries:
   ea=a.getAddress(e)
   dest.add(ea)
   Disassembler.getDisassembler(p,monitor,None).disassemble(ea,restriction,True)
  fn.setBody(restriction)
  JumpTable(a.getAddress(site),dest,True,0).writeOverride(fn)
  ok=True
  rows.append({'start':start,'site':site,'destinations':entries})
 finally:p.endTransaction(tx,ok)
print(json.dumps(rows))
